editorial.blurb: A cozy neighborhood gem serving excellent Thai and sushi with generous portions, warm hospitality, and flavors that punch well above their price point.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early (around 5pm) for a quieter, more intimate experience, and don't miss the Tom Yum soup served in a giant individual bowl—it's a standout.

topDishes.note: Signature best-seller packed with flavor for under $15; reviewers call it one of the best they've had
